run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the longest common subsequence of two strings with consecutive segments of at least length k
test_f_gold: test f_gold with multiple string pairs and minimum segment length k to verify LCS results
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which computes LCS using dynamic programming with consecutive segment constraints
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to improve time complexity of the nested loop over consecutive match segments
review_f_gold: review f_gold for correctness of the dynamic programming LCS approach with minimum segment length k
